title: Post-Flight Analysis: Starship Flight 14 Heat Shield Performance Reviewed
detail: Post-flight analysis of Starship Flight 14's heat shield performance during orbital reentry is underway, with experts assessing whether the thermal protection system met requirements that would validate SpaceX's reusability model. The analysis is critical to determining the pace of future Starship flights and the viability of rapid turnaround timelines central to the program's economics.
